out_items.name: Contamination prevented during food preparation, storage, and display

violations.title: Packaged Food Display, No Direct Contact Water/Ice
violations.observation: The following packaged food was found stored in direct contact with ice: Observed a bottle of water stored inside the ice machine.
violations.corrective_action: Packaged food may not be stored in direct contact with ice or water if the food is subject to the entry of water because of the nature of its packaging, wrapping, or container or its positioning in the ice or water. EHS discussed with PIC that the packaged food cannot be stored in direct contact with consumable ice. PIC removed the bottle of water and replaced the ice after cleaning and sanitizing the ice machine.

violations.title: Hair Restraints
violations.observation: Employees observed working in the food service area without proper hair restraints.
violations.corrective_action: Food employees shall wear hair restraints such as hats, visors, hair nets or beard nets to effectively keep their hair from contacting exposed food, clean equipment, utensils, linens, and unwrapped single-service items. This section does not apply to food employees such as counter staff who ONLY serve beverages and wrapped or packaged foods, hostesses, and wait staff. EHS had employee put on a hair guard.

out_items.name: Warewashing facilities installed, maintained and used; test strips

violations.title: Test Kit/Device for Chemical Sanitizer
violations.observation: There is no quaternary ammonia test kit located in the facility for monitoring the concentration of the chemical sanitizing solutions.
violations.corrective_action: PIC obtained a quaternary ammonia test kit during inspection.

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Handwashing Sink, Designated Use
violations.observation: EHS observed employee rinsing out blending guards in the designated handwashing sink.
violations.corrective_action: Handsinks are to be used only for washing hands to encourage proper hand washing and to prevent contamination of cleaned hands. Employee stopped rinsing out blending guards in the designated handwashing sink.

violations.title: Food Thermometers, Provided & Accessible
violations.observation: Employee thermometer was non functioning. Battery on thermometer was out of power.
violations.corrective_action: A metal-stemmed probe food thermometer shall be provided and readily accessible for use in ensuring attainment and maintenance of food temperatures. Employee replaced battery in thermometer.
